kev.note: Complete CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalogue, version 2026.10.30 (1,766 entries), in the published JSON schema. Pulled from cisa.gov on 2 November 2026 (see docs/BUILDLOG.md, S0). `python3 -m exposure_radio feeds refresh` replaces it with the current catalogue.

cross_checks.note: Entries used by the demo were independently cross-checked on 2026-11-02 against public catalogue mirrors and CISA alert coverage before the full file landed; the dates agreed.

epss.note: FIRST EPSS scores with score date 2026-10-30 for the CVE identifiers the synthetic tenants carry (19 entries), stored as {score_date, scores: {cve: {epss, percentile}}}. The previous day's scores are kept in epss-2026-10-29.json. The loader also reads the FIRST daily CSV (plain or gzip) and the FIRST API JSON response; `python3 -m exposure_radio feeds refresh` downloads the complete daily file.

tenable_research.note: Tenable Research publications that cover CVE identifiers in the demo fixtures. Titles and URLs were confirmed through web search on 2026-11-02; only tenable.com URLs are accepted by the loader. Publication dates are recorded only where confirmed.
